NutritionCalculation._comment: NutritionCalculator servisinin kullandigi katsayilar. Bolum atlanirsa NutritionCalculationOptions icindeki varsayilanlar kullanilir.

WorkoutPlanGeneration._comment: WorkoutPlanGenerator skorlama/kural katsayilari. Bolum atlanirsa WorkoutPlanGenerationOptions icindeki varsayilanlar kullanilir. Dictionary alanlar (SetsByGoalAndExperience, RepsRangeByGoal, RestSecondsByGoal) yalnizca kod icindeki varsayilanlardan okunur.

NutritionPlanGeneration._comment: NutritionPlanGenerator ogun dagilim yuzdeleri ve toleranslar. Bolum atlanirsa NutritionPlanGenerationOptions icindeki varsayilanlar kullanilir.

PersonalizationJobProcessing._comment: PersonalizationBackgroundWorker'in polling araligi ve retry siniri. Bolum atlanirsa PersonalizationJobProcessingOptions icindeki varsayilanlar (MaxAttemptCount=3, PollingInterval=15s) kullanilir.
